what_works: Geopolitics and India-centric rankings (Highest earning cities, Powerful countries)
Mystery and War history (1962 War, Mystery tags)
Hinglish or Hindi titles with heavy emoji usage (😱, 🇮🇳, 🔥)
Custom thumbnails: The top 11 videos all utilize custom thumbnails
Duration between 40-50 seconds: Allows enough time for a story build-up without losing pace

diagnosis.hook: Weak videos use 'Explained' or generic descriptions. Strong videos use 'Mystery', 'Top 5', or direct questions like 'Bharat kis number par hai?'
diagnosis.buildup: Educational topics (Photosynthesis) lack the 'Beats' found in the scripts of successful videos. There is no tension or 'enemy' to overcome.
diagnosis.visuals: There is a direct correlation between 'No Custom Thumbnail' and 'Under 100 views' in the recent data batch.
diagnosis.titles_topics: The audience ignores niche world history (Myeongnyang, Romans) and favors Indian pride or global power dynamics.
diagnosis.other: The 'hour_ist' data shows that 7 AM to 9 AM is a consistent sweet spot for the channel's high-performers.

hook_rules: Start with a 'Did you know' question specifically about India
Use 'Shocking' or 'Mystery' in the first 3 seconds
Immediately show a visual contrast (e.g., Rich vs Poor, Then vs Now)
Use a 'Negative Hook' (e.g., 'Don't search this on Google')
buildup_rules: Introduce a conflict or a 'But' moment at the 15-second mark
Use fast-paced background music that swells during the climax
Include at least 3 surprising micro-facts before the conclusion
Keep the 'reveal' for the final 5 seconds to maximize retention
visual_rules: Custom thumbnails are mandatory; use high-contrast red/yellow text
Add large on-screen captions for every word spoken
Use split-screen visuals if the topic is a comparison (India vs China)
Ensure the first frame is a high-quality, recognizable face or map
title_rules: Always include at least 2 emojis (one being 😱 or 🇮🇳)
Keep titles under 50 characters to avoid truncation
Include a 'Curiosity Gap' (e.g., 'The reason will shock you')
topic_rules: Focus on Indian Geopolitics (Border issues, Military strength)
Rankings and Comparisons (Top 5, India vs World)
Hidden History/Dark Secrets of famous Indian landmarks
avoid: Avoid pure English titles for educational/science topics
Stop posting 'Explained' style content; switch to 'Storytelling' style
Do not leave technical text like 'Description:' in the title
Avoid niche international history that doesn't involve India
